source: The router is small relative to a wide ZXNAME0000XZ expert, but it is not free. Its score computation grows withZXMATH0000XZ Switch Transformer explicitly notes this router term while observing that the expert computation need not grow with the total number of experts when only one expert is selected.
zh: 该路由器相对于广泛的 ZXNAME0000XZ 专家来说很小，但它不是免费的。其分数计算随着ZXMATH0000XZ Switch Transformer 的增长而增长，Switch Transformer 明确指出了该路由器术语，同时观察到，当仅选择一名专家时，专家计算不需要随着专家总数的增长而增长。
